### Discrepancy Fixed: `remove-uwp-photos`
- **Before:** Toggle existed in playbook.conf (line 150) but was NOT used as an `option:` gate on any directive in custom.yml
- **After:** 7 `option: 'remove-uwp-photos'` gates added to Section 12 Legacy Photo Viewer registry entries
- **Rationale:** per CLAUDE.md, this toggle should "only control the Legacy Photo Viewer registry entries in Section 12" — the UWP Photos app itself is always kept

## Table 3: Executable Audit (AUDIT-03)

| File | In Executables/ | Referenced in custom.yml? | How Used | Status |
|------|-----------------|--------------------------|----------|--------|
| `DisableDefender.ps1` | YES | YES (Section 6) | `!powerShell: {exe: 'DisableDefender.ps1', exeDir: true}` | DIRECT |
| `EnableDefender.ps1` | YES | NO (comments only) | Referenced in comment block: "EnableDefender.ps1 can restore" | INTENDED (restoration script, not apply-time) |

| `settimerresolutionservice.cs` | YES | YES (Section 31) | `!command: Set-FileContent -Path ... settimerresolutionservice.cs` | DIRECT |
| `start2.bin` | YES | YES (Section 26) | PowerShell: `Join-Path $PWD 'start2.bin'` | DIRECT |
| `profile.png` | YES | YES (Section 36) | PowerShell: `Join-Path $PWD 'profile.png'` | DIRECT |
| `NoDefender.cab` | YES (in Files/Windows/) | NO (deployed by Section 1, used by DisableDefender.ps1) | `robocopy Files/Windows C:\Windows\` deploys to C:\Windows\NoDefender.cab; DisableDefender.ps1 references at runtime | INDIRECT (runtime dependency) |
| `ControlPanelSettings.reg` | YES | NO (comment only) | Comment: "ControlPanelSettings.reg inlined + runtime PS blocks"; content inlined in Section 26 | INTENDED (dead reference / inlined) |

### Summary
- **4 direct references:** DisableDefender.ps1, SetFileTypeAssociation.ps1, settimerresolutionservice.cs, start2.bin, profile.png (5 total)
- **1 indirect reference:** NoDefender.cab (deployed by Section 01, used by DisableDefender.ps1 at runtime)
- **2 intended references:** EnableDefender.ps1 (restoration script), ControlPanelSettings.reg (inlined, dead reference)
- **0 orphaned files** — every file in Executables/ has a purpose

## Discrepancies Logged

| # | Issue | Type | Action Taken |
|---|-------|------|-------------|
| 1 | `remove-uwp-photos` toggle was dead (header in Section 12 claimed it, but no directives used it) | Functional bug | **Fixed** — Added 7 Legacy Photo Viewer registry entries with `option: 'remove-uwp-photos'` gates |
| 2 | Section 10 header said "Firefox Dev" but was replaced with LibreWolf in August 2026 | Stale comment | **Fixed** — Header updated to "LibreWolf" |
| 3 | `firefox.png` image in Images/ has no corresponding toggle in playbook.conf | Orphaned asset | **Deferred** — Noted for Phase 3 cleanup |
| 4 | `NoDefender.cab` not referenced directly in custom.yml | Documentation gap | **No action** — Indirect reference via DisableDefender.ps1 is correct by design |
| 5 | `ControlPanelSettings.reg` only in comments, content inlined | Dead reference | **No action** — Per CLAUDE.md: "dead reference, kept for historical context only" |
| 6 | `EnableDefender.ps1` only in comments | Intentional | **No action** — Restoration script, not apply-time |
